raw: {"analysis":"RJM provides a more thorough and practical plan, particularly around CI cost management (avoiding unnecessary 45-minute runs), golden set specification, and coordinating with downstream service owners. MBT has some questionable elements: marking the flaky test as \"non-blocking\" could mask real issues, the 1,000-image batch test seems arbitrary, and the rollback pipeline estimate of 15 minutes is unsubstantiated. RJM's approach to the flaky test (reproduce on previous stable release to prove pre-existing) is more rigorous than MBT's suggestion to simply mark it non-blocking.","verdict":"RJM"}
